name: Social Cross-Post
description: Compose one message, then adapt it for Twitter, LinkedIn, and Reddit in parallel.

stages.name: Draft core message
stages.prompt: Write a 280-character core message about the supplied topic. Neutral tone, no emojis.

stages.name: Adapt for Twitter
stages.prompt: Adapt the core message for Twitter: punchy, hashtag-light, 280 chars max.

stages.name: Adapt for LinkedIn
stages.prompt: Adapt the core message for LinkedIn: professional tone, 1-2 short paragraphs, one CTA.

stages.name: Adapt for Reddit
stages.prompt: Adapt the core message for r/programming style: conversational, no marketing fluff, no hashtags.
